prompt:
Build a Simulink virtual-commissioning model of an automated assembly line with two stationary six-axis industrial-robot workcells, four independently scheduled mobile shuttles, incoming cups and balls, and an unloading station. Robot 1 must pick a cup and place it on the selected shuttle. Robot 2 must pick a ball and insert it into that cup. The shuttle must then deliver the completed product for unloading before it is reused.

Each robot arm must generate joint motion, apply actuator torque to its manipulator dynamics, and use measured joint position and velocity in closed-loop tracking. A supervisory sequence must coordinate both robot completion states, the selected shuttle, object attachment and release, and unloading. The implementation must support consecutive products on different shuttles rather than replaying only the first transfer.

Read BallOffsetXY from the MATLAB base workspace as a 1-by-2 planar pickup-location offset in metres. Each component will remain between -0.03 m and 0.03 m. The line must recover the correct ball location within robot reach and complete the corresponding handoff without bypassing the robot dynamics or directly teleporting a completed product.

Simulate long enough to demonstrate both robot workcells, one complete cup-ball-unload cycle, and the start of a later shuttle cycle. Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named robot1_joint_reference, robot1_joint_state, robot1_joint_torque, robot2_joint_reference, robot2_joint_state, robot2_joint_torque, line_supervisor, task_state, and actor_transfer_state. For each robot, joint_reference and joint_state have 18 channels in joint 1--6 order: six positions (rad), six velocities (rad/s), and six accelerations (rad/s^2); joint_torque has 6 channels in joint 1--6 order (N*m). line_supervisor has 19 channels in this order: shuttle 1--4 x,y,yaw groups; robot1 go and shuttle id; robot2 go and shuttle id; ball instance id; cup-destroy stage 1; and cup-destroy stage 2. task_state has 2 channels [robot1 task state,robot2 task state]. actor_transfer_state has 5 channels [cup attached to robot1,cup attached to shuttle,ball attached to robot2,ball inserted into cup,completed product unloaded]. Save the completed model as cand_XROBO10.slx in the submission directory and keep its latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XROBO10.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
